lede: GT Continental is a car workshop in Sin Ming Industrial Estate. Its own website lists servicing and repair, engine repair and overhaul, automatic transmission repair and aircon cleaning and repair.
themes: Customers on Google Maps mention Mercedes-Benz servicing with genuine parts after the dealer warranty ends, fixing faults other workshops could not, such as parking sensors, and advice to keep parts that do not need changing.
services_note: Services as listed on the workshop's own website, gtcontinental.sg.
makes_note: Named on its own website. Ask the workshop about other makes.
good_to_know: Established in 1989, according to its website
